body:
## Pull request overview

Removes the deprecated OData-era `value` alias from the `findData` protocol response so that only the spec-defined `records` field is returned, and updates key consumers (Studio + examples + tests) accordingly.

**Changes:**
- Updated `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.findData()` to return `{ records }` only (no `value` alias).
- Updated Studio, example app, and related tests to use `records` instead of `value`.
- Documented the breaking change in `CHANGELOG.md` and updated Studio roadmap status.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/objectql/src/protocol.ts | Stop emitting deprecated `value` field; return spec-compliant `records` only. |
| apps/studio/src/components/ObjectDataTable.tsx | Remove `.value` fallback when reading `findData` results. |
| apps/studio/test/api.test.ts | Update test helper to no longer rely on `response.value`. |
| examples/app-host/public/index.html | Update example UI fetch parsing from `json.value` to `json.records`. |
| examples/app-host/test/e2e.test.ts | Update E2E assertions and logging to use `records`. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Record breaking change under `[Unreleased]`. |
| apps/studio/ROADMAP.md | Mark response normalization task as done (status update). |
</details>

`findData()` always sets `total: records.length` and `hasMore: false`, which is incorrect when `top/skip` (limit/offset) pagination is used. This breaks spec semantics (FindDataResponseSchema `total` is the total matching count) and causes pagination UIs (e.g. Studio) to compute only 1 page. Since ObjectQLEngine supports `count()`, consider computing `total` via `this.engine.count(object, { where: options.where, context: options.context })` when `count===true`, and set `hasMore` based on `offset + records.length < total` (or omit `total/hasMore` when not requested).

The changelog entry states that “protocol-to-OData adaptation is handled in the HTTP dispatch layer”, but there doesn’t appear to be an OData HTTP layer/endpoint in the repo today (and current REST/Hono CRUD handlers return the protocol response directly). Consider rewording this to avoid implying an existing adaptation (e.g. “OData responses (when exposed) should adapt `records` → `value` in the HTTP layer”), or link to the concrete adapter/route if it exists elsewhere.
```suggestion
  the OData v4 standard — when exposed over HTTP as OData, responses should adapt
  `records` → `value` in the HTTP dispatch layer.
```

This roadmap item is marked “Done”, but Studio still has multiple inline response-shape fallbacks (e.g. `(result as any).value` in `src/components/app-sidebar.tsx:219` and `src/hooks/use-api-discovery.ts:265`, plus other `.value` unwrapping in `src/lib/create-broker-shim.ts`). Either keep this task open, or narrow the wording to reflect that only `findData.value` was removed rather than centralizing normalization across the app.
